subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961, or should the overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 own the change?
rationale: Both branches modify the same delivery invariant, neither has external real-behavior proof, and only a maintainer should choose which branch receives the remaining proof and any model-guidance alignment before the other closes.

options.title: Sponsor this PR after proof
options.body: Use this branch's broader bridge regression coverage, incorporate or explicitly reject the competing schema clarification, and require live Discord/Codex exactly-once proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 as canonical if its model-facing guidance is preferred, but require equivalent live proof before closing this PR as superseded.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both unmerged until a maintainer-owned implementation or proof run establishes the intended canonical semantics.
